servicer_name.description: Name of the mortgage servicer issuing the statement.

borrower_name.description: Borrower named in the mailing address block.

property_address.description: Property address as printed, on one line.

analysis_result.description: Outcome of the escrow analysis as stated in the letter.

new_monthly_payment.description: Section 1, the new monthly mortgage payment and the table comparing current and new payment components.

new_total_monthly_payment.description: The headline new monthly mortgage payment, in dollars.

effective_date.description: Month the new payment takes effect, as YYYY-MM.

current_principal_and_interest.description: Current principal and interest amount, in dollars.

new_principal_and_interest.description: New principal and interest amount, in dollars.

current_escrow_payment.description: Current monthly escrow payment, in dollars.

new_escrow_payment.description: New monthly escrow payment, in dollars.

shortage_or_surplus_payment.description: Monthly surplus/shortage amount included in the new payment, in dollars. Null if blank.

current_total_monthly_payment.description: Current total monthly payment, in dollars.

monthly_payment_difference.description: Difference in monthly payment, in dollars. Positive when the payment increases.

annual_disbursements.description: Section 2, each tax or insurance type with its current and new annual amount. Exclude the Annual Amount total row.

type.description: Tax or insurance type, e.g. City Tax.

current_annual_escrow_total.description: Current total annual escrow amount (Annual Amount row, CURRENT column), in dollars.

new_annual_escrow_total.description: New total annual escrow amount (Annual Amount row, NEW column), in dollars.

cushion_months.description: Number of months of escrow payment the account must always maintain.

required_minimum_escrow_balance.description: Required minimum escrow balance, in dollars.

shortage_amount.description: Shortage amount, in dollars. Null if there is no shortage.

surplus_amount.description: Surplus or overage amount, in dollars. Null if there is no surplus.

projection.description: Section 4, the anticipated escrow activity over the next 12 months.

low_point_required_balance.description: Required minimum balance at the low point (marked LP), in dollars.

anticipated_lowest_balance.description: Anticipated lowest account balance, in dollars.

low_point_month.description: Month the lowest balance is reached, as YYYY-MM.

rows.description: Each monthly row of the anticipated escrow amounts table. Exclude the opening balance and total rows.

description.description: Disbursement description, e.g. CITY/TWN TAX. Null if blank.

paid_in.description: Anticipated amount paid into escrow, in dollars.

paid_out.description: Anticipated amount paid out of escrow, in dollars.

required_balance.description: Required escrow account balance, in dollars.

history.description: Section 5, escrow account history comparing estimated and actual activity over the past year.

interest_on_escrow.description: Interest on escrow deposited over the period, in dollars.

rows.description: Each monthly row of the escrow account history table. Exclude the opening balance and totals rows.

paid_to_escrow_estimated.description: Estimated amount paid to escrow, in dollars.

paid_to_escrow_actual.description: Actual amount paid to escrow, in dollars, without any * or E flag.

paid_from_escrow_estimated.description: Estimated amount paid from escrow, in dollars. Null if blank.

paid_from_escrow_actual.description: Actual amount paid from escrow, in dollars, without any * flag. Null if blank.

differs_from_projection.description: True if any amount in the row carries an asterisk (*).

estimated_not_yet_happened.description: True if the row carries the letter E.
